The triads primarily consist of 3rds
and 6ths with some 4ths and 5ths, but contain no 2nds or 7ths.While the 3-part 4ths primar-
ily consist of 4ths and 5ths with some 2nds and 7ths, but contain no 3rds or 6ths. Clearly,

quotes.why_load_bearing: This passage defines the fundamental interval-content distinction between triads and 3-part 4th voicings, which is the conceptual core of the comparative analysis in this chapter.

quotes.why_load_bearing: This observation articulates the structural rule that certain chord families (7th no-3rd, 7th no-5th, TBN I, TBN II) share even interval distribution across both 3- and 4-part voicings, which is a key analytical finding for understanding voicing families.
